posts.text:
As I have always stated, I will stay in Washington and work as long as it takes to get the job done.

Right now, our work is getting the SAVE America Act passed, the Russia-Iran Sanctions bill passed, confirming President Trump’s nominees, and preventing another Democratic shutdown before the August state work period. 

Our job is to work for the people who sent us here and deliver results. End of story.

Thrilled to see the Rural Obstetrics Readiness Act unanimously advance out of @GOPHELP. 

Since taking office, I’ve been proud to work on improving healthcare outcomes for women and rural Alabamians across our state because every woman deserves access to quality maternity care, no matter her zip code. 

I am committed to getting this bipartisan bill across the finish line. britt.senate.gov/news/press-…

posts.text:
Today I was asked why I felt called to serve Alabama. The answer is simple: I love our state.

To the Alabamians, families, and Capitol Hill interns who joined Coffee with Katie this morning, thank you! What an honor and a privilege to represent you all in the U.S. Senate.

Tonight, an overwhelming majority of my Senate colleagues and I advanced sanctions legislation at a critical juncture in this war: where Russia is the weakest it’s been in years.

The time is now to honor Senator Lindsey Graham’s legacy by giving President Trump the economic firepower he needs to end Putin’s war of aggression and hold Tehran accountable for fueling 47 years of terrorism across the globe. 

Let’s get this done.
